A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CARINOX paper, with 34 readable pages including Appendices A–M. Full text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to the version stamp and one bibliography entry.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark experiments, a human evaluation, and ablations in Sections 5–6, plus additional empirical results in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original benchmark, human-evaluation, ablation, and appendix results.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 are identical, retaining the same noise optimization, seed exploration, reward combination, gradient clipping, and regularization.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same T2I-CompBench++, HRS, MS-COCO, and GenEval coverage, including the same task categories and appendix evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including comparisons with ReNO, ImageSelect, Pick-a-Pic, InitNO, and Attend-and-Excite.

E3.justification: Evaluation settings are identical, including the 200-prompt human study, seven annotators, scoring protocol, default optimization configuration, and NFE-matched comparisons in Appendix I.2.

E4.justification: The iteration/seed and individual-reward ablations in Section 6, correlation analysis, and appendix studies of refinement, clipping, adaptive weighting, and regularization are unchanged.

E5.justification: Seed information, statistical reporting, and aggregation procedures are unchanged. Table 8 retains the same gradient-norm means and standard deviations; no uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains CARINOX means of 0.5734, 0.5715, and 0.5776 for SD-Turbo, SDXL-Turbo, and PixArt-α DMD, respectively.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(15), the noise-prior assumptions, and Appendix B's mathematical preliminaries are identical. No definitions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims about combined optimization/exploration, compositional alignment, and preservation of image quality and diversity.

C2.justification: Interpretations of reward complementarity, initialization failures, regularization, and computational overhead are unchanged, as are Appendix A's applicability boundaries and future-work discussion.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, pseudocode, H100 runtime/memory reporting, and project-access information are unchanged. The updated arXiv self-link only identifies the later document version.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. The revised Kasaei et al. (2025) entry retains the same authors and title and changes only publication metadata.

P1.justification: v3 updates the arXiv version/date stamp and replaces 'In Generative and Protective AI for Content Creation' with 'arXiv preprint arXiv:2509.21227' for Kasaei et al. (2025). All other text and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–15, Tables 1–13, Algorithm 1, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered differences are confined to the edited stamp and one bibliography line, without reflow.

improvement.justification: The only edits concern document-version labeling and publication metadata for an already cited work. Scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility details, and presentation structure remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
